cases.why: Cpca 536 مكرر 4 ¶3 requires attachment of the non-conciliation record; delivery of two records does not establish attachment, so ask whether either was attached. Also ask when the relevant specialised court was installed and whether this action was filed in the ordinary commercial section before then, under law-22-13 13 ¶1–2. The three months in cpca 536 مكرر 4 ¶1 governs conducting conciliation, not filing after delivery of either record.

cases.why: Cpca 536 مكرر ¶5 and 531 ¶1 allocate this category to the specialised commercial court, but law-22-13 13 ¶1–2 makes that allocation effective upon installation and preserves earlier ordinary commercial proceedings. Ask when the relevant specialised court was installed and whether this action was filed in the ordinary commercial section before that date; the petition date alone does not establish that it leaves the ordinary court.

However, law-22-13 13 ¶1–2 preserves ordinary commercial proceedings filed before installation, so ask for the relevant installation date and whether this action was filed there before that date before deciding stepMissing.
